**Configuration:**
- The session cookie name is `session_token`.
- Folder name length is 1 to 80 characters inclusive after trimming; whitespace-only names are treated as empty.
- Folder name uniqueness is per user and case-insensitive: "Courses" and "courses" are duplicates of each other.
- Supported `folderId` query parameter values on `GET /api/videos` are exactly: a UUID matching a folder owned by the actor (filters to that folder), the literal `unfiled` (filters to videos with `folder_id IS NULL`), absent (no folder filter, F04 default), or any other value (silently falls back to no folder filter).
- The `tagId` query parameter on `GET /api/videos` is recognized; combined with `folderId`, it applies the folder leg of an AND. F05 ships an internal `tagId` pass-through guard that activates the SQL join only when the `video_tags` table is present at runtime; when the table is absent, the parameter is a no-op so the folder-only set is returned (which is the F05-observable side of the AND).
- The PATCH body for `/api/videos/{id}` accepts `folderId: <uuid> | null` alongside the existing `title` and `description` fields; absence of `folderId` means unchanged, an explicit `null` unfiles the video, and a UUID assigns the video to that folder.
- The web app proxies `/api/folders`, `/api/folders/{id}`, and the extended `/api/videos` and `/api/videos/{id}` routes to the backend while preserving request cookies and response bodies.
- The `/app` URL convention for sidebar selection is `?folder=<uuid>` for a folder, `?folder=unfiled` for the unfiled view, and the parameter omitted for "All videos"; unknown `?folder=` values silently fall back to "All videos".

## HTTP API

**Verification mode:** Send an HTTP request to the running service; assert response status, headers, body, and any direct persisted side-effect.

### Folder List

**Common given:** `folder-user` has an active `session_token` cookie and the seeded folders and videos exist with their declared associations.

#### `API-FOLDER-LIST-01` — list returns every owned folder alphabetically with video counts
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/folders` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body folders are ordered alphabetically by name (`Archive`, `Courses`, `Meetings`)
  - the `Courses` entry has `videoCount` equal to 2 (`vid-in-courses`, `vid-also-in-courses`)
  - the `Meetings` entry has `videoCount` equal to its seeded count
  - no folder owned by `other-user` is present in the body

### Folder Create

**Common given:** `folder-user` has an active `session_token` cookie.

#### `API-FOLDER-CREATE-01` — valid name creates the folder
- given: (default), and no folder named "Travel" exists for `folder-user`
- when: POST `/api/folders` with body `{ "name": "Travel" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 201
  - body folder has a non-empty `id`, `name` "Travel", and `videoCount` 0
  - a persisted folder for `folder-user` exists with name "Travel"

#### `API-FOLDER-CREATE-02` — case-insensitive duplicate name is rejected
- given: (default), and `folder-courses` exists with name "Courses"
- when: POST `/api/folders` with body `{ "name": "courses" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 409
  - body code is `duplicate_folder_name`
  - body message identifies "courses" as the offending value
  - no new folder is persisted for `folder-user`

#### `API-FOLDER-CREATE-03` — empty or whitespace name is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST `/api/folders` with body `{ "name": "   " }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 400
  - body code is `invalid_folder_name`
  - body message identifies the offending value and names the 1–80 character bounds
  - no folder is persisted for `folder-user`

#### `API-FOLDER-CREATE-04` — name at the eighty-character boundary is accepted
- given: (default), and the candidate name is a string of exactly 80 characters not used by any existing folder
- when: POST `/api/folders` with that name and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 201
  - body folder has the supplied 80-character name
  - a persisted folder for `folder-user` exists with that name

#### `API-FOLDER-CREATE-05` — name above eighty characters is rejected
- given: (default), and the candidate name is a string of 81 characters
- when: POST `/api/folders` with that name and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 400
  - body code is `invalid_folder_name`
  - body message names the 80-character upper bound
  - no folder is persisted for `folder-user`

### Folder Rename

**Common given:** `folder-user` has an active `session_token` cookie.

#### `API-FOLDER-RENAME-01` — valid rename updates the folder
- given: (default), and `folder-courses` has name "Courses"
- when: PATCH `/api/folders/{folder-courses.id}` with body `{ "name": "Courses · NLP" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body folder name is "Courses · NLP"
  - the persisted folder name for `folder-courses` is "Courses · NLP"

#### `API-FOLDER-RENAME-02` — empty or whitespace name is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: PATCH `/api/folders/{folder-courses.id}` with body `{ "name": "   " }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 400
  - body code is `invalid_folder_name`
  - body message identifies the offending value
  - the persisted name for `folder-courses` is unchanged

#### `API-FOLDER-RENAME-03` — rename to another existing folder's name is rejected
- given: (default), and both `folder-courses` ("Courses") and `folder-meetings` ("Meetings") exist
- when: PATCH `/api/folders/{folder-courses.id}` with body `{ "name": "Meetings" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 409
  - body code is `duplicate_folder_name`
  - the persisted name for `folder-courses` is unchanged

#### `API-FOLDER-RENAME-04` — renaming another user's folder returns not found
- given: (default), and the target folder is `other-user-folder` (owned by `other-user`)
- when: PATCH `/api/folders/{other-user-folder.id}` with body `{ "name": "Hijack" }` and `folder-user`'s active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 404
  - body code is `folder_not_found`
  - the persisted name for `other-user-folder` is unchanged

### Folder Delete

**Common given:** `folder-user` has an active `session_token` cookie.

#### `API-FOLDER-DELETE-01` — confirmed delete unfiles its videos and removes the folder row
- given: (default), and `folder-meetings` has at least one associated video (`vid-in-meetings`) with `folderId` pointing to `folder-meetings`
- when: DELETE `/api/folders/{folder-meetings.id}` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 204
  - no `folders` row exists for `folder-meetings`
  - the persisted `vid-in-meetings` row still exists
  - the persisted `vid-in-meetings.folderId` is `null`

#### `API-FOLDER-DELETE-02` — deleting an empty folder removes only the folder row
- given: a freshly created folder for `folder-user` with name "Empty" and zero associated videos
- when: DELETE `/api/folders/{Empty.id}` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 204
  - no `folders` row exists for that id
  - the persisted `vid-in-courses.folderId` is unchanged (still pointing to `folder-courses`)

#### `API-FOLDER-DELETE-03` — deleting another user's folder returns not found
- given: (default), and the target folder is `other-user-folder`
- when: DELETE `/api/folders/{other-user-folder.id}` with `folder-user`'s active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 404
  - body code is `folder_not_found`
  - the persisted `other-user-folder` row is unchanged

### Video Assign

**Common given:** `folder-user` has an active `session_token` cookie.

#### `API-ASSIGN-01` — assigning an unfiled video to a folder updates folderId
- given: (default), and `vid-unfiled-a` has `folderId` `null`
- when: PATCH `/api/videos/{vid-unfiled-a.id}` with body `{ "folderId": "{folder-courses.id}" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body video `folderId` equals `folder-courses.id`
  - the persisted `vid-unfiled-a.folderId` equals `folder-courses.id`

#### `API-ASSIGN-02` — moving an assigned video to a different folder replaces the previous assignment
- given: (default), `vid-unfiled-a` has just been assigned to `folder-courses` via API-ASSIGN-01, and `folder-meetings` exists
- when: PATCH `/api/videos/{vid-unfiled-a.id}` with body `{ "folderId": "{folder-meetings.id}" }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body video `folderId` equals `folder-meetings.id`
  - the persisted `vid-unfiled-a.folderId` equals `folder-meetings.id` (the prior `folder-courses` association is replaced)

#### `API-ASSIGN-03` — explicit null unfiles the video
- given: (default), and `vid-unfiled-a` has `folderId` pointing to `folder-courses`
- when: PATCH `/api/videos/{vid-unfiled-a.id}` with body `{ "folderId": null }` and the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body video `folderId` is `null`
  - the persisted `vid-unfiled-a.folderId` is `null`

#### `API-ASSIGN-04` — assigning a video the actor does not own returns video not found
- given: (default), and the target video is `vid-in-courses` (owned by `folder-user`) but the actor cookie is `other-user`'s active `session_token`
- when: PATCH `/api/videos/{vid-in-courses.id}` with body `{ "folderId": "{folder-meetings.id}" }` and `other-user`'s active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 404
  - body code is `video_not_found`
  - the persisted `vid-in-courses.folderId` is unchanged

#### `API-ASSIGN-05` — assigning to a folder owned by another user returns folder not found
- given: (default), `vid-unfiled-a` is owned by `folder-user`, and the target folder is `other-user-folder`
- when: PATCH `/api/videos/{vid-unfiled-a.id}` with body `{ "folderId": "{other-user-folder.id}" }` and `folder-user`'s active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 404
  - body code is `folder_not_found`
  - the persisted `vid-unfiled-a.folderId` is unchanged

### Library Filter

**Common given:** `folder-user` has an active `session_token` cookie and the seeded folders and videos exist with their declared associations.

#### `API-FILTER-FOLDER-01` — folderId UUID returns only that folder's videos
- given: (default), and `folder-courses` contains `vid-in-courses` and `vid-also-in-courses`
- when: GET `/api/videos?folderId={folder-courses.id}` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body videos include `vid-in-courses` and `vid-also-in-courses` and only those
  - no body video has a `folderId` other than `folder-courses.id`

#### `API-FILTER-UNFILED-01` — folderId=unfiled returns only videos without a folder
- given: (default), and `vid-unfiled-a` and `vid-unfiled-b` have `folderId` `null`
- when: GET `/api/videos?folderId=unfiled` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body videos include `vid-unfiled-a` and `vid-unfiled-b` and only videos whose `folderId` is `null`
  - no body video has a non-null `folderId`

#### `API-FILTER-ALL-01` — absent folderId returns the F04 default (every owned video)
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/videos` with the active session cookie and no `folderId` query parameter
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body videos include every seeded `folder-user` video, regardless of folder association

#### `API-FILTER-UNKNOWN-01` — unknown folderId silently falls back to All videos
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/videos?folderId=not-a-uuid` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body videos include every seeded `folder-user` video, identical to API-FILTER-ALL-01

#### `API-FILTER-COMBINE-01` — folderId combined with tagId applies the folder leg of the AND
- given: (default), `folder-courses` contains `vid-in-courses` and `vid-also-in-courses`, and the F05-internal `tagId` pass-through is in its default no-tag-table state (the F06 `video_tags` table is not yet present in this contract environment)
- when: GET `/api/videos?folderId={folder-courses.id}&tagId={any-uuid}` with the active session cookie
- then:
  - response status is 200
  - body videos include `vid-in-courses` and `vid-also-in-courses` and only those (the folder leg of the AND is enforced; the tag leg degrades to a no-op against the absent `video_tags` table)
  - no body video has a `folderId` other than `folder-courses.id`
- notes: F06 is outside F05's PRD §8 dependency closure; this item exercises the AND semantics through F05's own deliverable (the `tagId` parameter and the pass-through guard). When F06 ships and starts populating `video_tags`, the same endpoint activates the full AND without a contract change.

## UI

**Verification mode:** Render the surface, drive it with user-like inputs (clicks, typing, gestures); assert observable surface state (DOM, accessibility tree, visible text, navigation).

### Sidebar Render

**Common given:** the browser is authenticated as `folder-user` and the seeded folders exist.

#### `UI-SIDEBAR-RENDER-01` — sidebar shows All videos, Unfiled, then user folders alphabetically
- given: (default)
- when: render `/app`
- then:
  - the sidebar shows an entry labeled "All videos" first
  - the sidebar shows an entry labeled "Unfiled" immediately after "All videos"
  - the sidebar shows the user folders below in alphabetical order (`Archive`, `Courses`, `Meetings`)
  - each folder row shows its video count

#### `UI-SIDEBAR-RENDER-02` — newly created folder appears alphabetically without a reload
- given: (default), and `/app` has just rendered with `folder-courses` and `folder-archive` visible in the sidebar
- when: trigger an inline folder creation with the name "Bravo" through the sidebar
- then:
  - the sidebar shows the new "Bravo" folder between `Archive` and `Courses` without a full page reload
  - the persisted folders for `folder-user` include one named "Bravo"

### Sidebar Create

**Common given:** the browser is authenticated as `folder-user` and `/app` is open.

#### `UI-SIDEBAR-CREATE-01` — inline create accepts a valid name and adds it to the sidebar
- given: (default), and no folder named "Travel" exists for `folder-user`
- when: open the inline "+ New folder" affordance, type "Travel", and submit with Enter
- then:
  - the sidebar shows a new "Travel" entry alphabetically
  - the persisted folders for `folder-user` include one named "Travel"
  - the inline input closes after submission

#### `UI-SIDEBAR-CREATE-02` — inline create surfaces the duplicate-name error
- given: (default), and `folder-courses` exists with name "Courses"
- when: open the inline "+ New folder" affordance, type "courses", and submit
- then:
  - an inline message identifies the duplicate name
  - the inline input remains open with the typed value preserved
  - no new folder is persisted for `folder-user`

### Sidebar Rename

**Common given:** the browser is authenticated as `folder-user` and `/app` is open.

#### `UI-SIDEBAR-RENAME-01` — inline rename updates the sidebar entry immediately
- given: (default), and `folder-courses` is visible in the sidebar with name "Courses"
- when: open `folder-courses`'s sidebar context menu, choose "Rename", type "Courses · NLP", and submit
- then:
  - the sidebar entry for `folder-courses` shows "Courses · NLP" without a full page reload
  - the persisted folder name for `folder-courses` is "Courses · NLP"

### Sidebar Delete

**Common given:** the browser is authenticated as `folder-user` and `/app` is open with `folder-meetings` visible in the sidebar.

#### `UI-SIDEBAR-DELETE-01` — confirmed delete removes the entry and unfiles its videos
- given: (default), and `folder-meetings` has at least one associated video
- when: open `folder-meetings`'s sidebar context menu, choose "Delete", and confirm in the modal
- then:
  - a confirmation modal appeared with the text "Delete folder 'Meetings'? Its videos will move to Unfiled."
  - the sidebar entry for `folder-meetings` disappears
  - no `folders` row exists for `folder-meetings`
  - every video that previously referenced `folder-meetings` now has `folderId` `null`

### Library Filter

**Common given:** the browser is authenticated as `folder-user` and the seeded folders and videos exist with their declared associations.

#### `UI-FILTER-FOLDER-01` — clicking a folder filters the library and updates the URL
- given: (default), and `/app` is open
- when: click the sidebar entry for `folder-courses`
- then:
  - the URL becomes `/app?folder={folder-courses.id}`
  - the library renders only videos whose `folderId` equals `folder-courses.id` (`vid-in-courses` is visible; no unfiled video is visible)
  - the sidebar entry for `folder-courses` is marked as the active selection

#### `UI-FILTER-UNFILED-01` — clicking Unfiled filters the library to videos with no folder
- given: (default), and `/app` is open
- when: click the sidebar entry for "Unfiled"
- then:
  - the URL becomes `/app?folder=unfiled`
  - the library renders only videos whose `folderId` is `null` (`vid-unfiled-a` and `vid-unfiled-b` are visible; `vid-in-courses` is not visible)
  - the sidebar entry for "Unfiled" is marked as the active selection

#### `UI-FILTER-COMBINE-01` — folder filter combined with an active tag filter shows the folder leg
- given: (default), `/app?folder={folder-courses.id}` is open, and the F05-internal `tagId` pass-through is in its default no-tag-table state
- when: drive the library list to also send a `tagId` query parameter (via the F05-shipped tag-filter mechanism inside the library shell, with any UUID value)
- then:
  - the library renders only videos whose `folderId` equals `folder-courses.id` (the folder leg of the AND is enforced)
  - no unfiled video is visible
- notes: F06 is outside F05's PRD §8 dependency closure; the combined filter is driven through F05's own `tagId` parameter and pass-through guard. With the `video_tags` table absent, the tag leg degrades to a no-op so the folder leg is the observable side of the AND.

### Move To Folder

**Common given:** the browser is authenticated as `folder-user` and `/app` is open.

#### `UI-MOVE-01` — move-to-folder assigns an unfiled video to a chosen folder
- given: (default), `vid-unfiled-a` is visible in the library, and `folder-courses` exists
- when: open `vid-unfiled-a`'s card menu, choose "Move to folder", select "Courses", and submit
- then:
  - the move-to-folder dialog closes
  - the persisted `vid-unfiled-a.folderId` equals `folder-courses.id`
  - clicking the sidebar "Courses" entry shows `vid-unfiled-a` in the library

#### `UI-MOVE-02` — moving an assigned video to a different folder replaces the previous assignment
- given: (default), `vid-in-courses` is visible in the library and currently has `folderId` pointing to `folder-courses`
- when: open `vid-in-courses`'s card menu, choose "Move to folder", select "Meetings", and submit
- then:
  - the move-to-folder dialog closes
  - the persisted `vid-in-courses.folderId` equals `folder-meetings.id`
  - the persisted `vid-in-courses.folderId` is no longer equal to `folder-courses.id` (the single-folder-per-video rule holds)
